s: a cycling café named for the point where four London boroughs meet
w: Opened by three friends, Tom, Ed and Ben, on Church Road in Crystal Palace -- named after the nearby point where the boroughs of Croydon, Bromley, Lambeth and Southwark all meet. Coffee, beer and kombucha for a rider crowd that's since supported a second branch in Loughborough Junction.
_facts: Located at 10 Church Road, Crystal Palace, London SE19 2ET
Named after a nearby boundary point where four London boroughs (Croydon, Bromley, Lambeth, Southwark) meet
Has a second location in Loughborough Junction
